# API Contract — v1

Single endpoint. Every request is an HTTP **POST** with a JSON body.

- Production (browser): `POST /api/v1`  → Netlify Function gateway → Google Apps Script.
- The browser **never** knows the Apps Script URL (it lives in a Netlify env var).

## Request envelope

```json
{
  "action": "createSale",
  "token": "<session token> | null",
  "requestId": "<uuid generated by client>",
  "clientTime": "2026-01-01T10:00:00.000Z",
  "appVersion": "1.0.0",
  "payload": { }
}
```

## Response envelope

```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "action": "createSale",
  "requestId": "...",
  "data": { },
  "error": null,
  "serverTime": "2026-01-01T10:00:01.000Z",
  "version": "1.0.0"
}
```

Error response: `ok:false`, `data:null`, `error:{ "code":"FORBIDDEN", "message":"..." }`.

Error codes: `BAD_REQUEST`, `UNAUTHORIZED`, `FORBIDDEN`, `NOT_FOUND`, `CONFLICT`,
`RATE_LIMITED`, `VALIDATION`, `SERVER_ERROR`, `UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT`, `IDEMPOTENT_REPLAY`.

---

## Actions

### Auth
| action | payload | data |
|---|---|---|
| `signup` | `{ fullName, dob, email, username, password, profession, profilePicture? }` | `{ userId }` |
| `login` | `{ identifier, password }` | `{ token, expiresAt, user }` |
| `refreshToken` | `{}` (uses header token) | `{ token, expiresAt }` |
| `logout` | `{}` | `{ loggedOut:true }` |
| `forgotPassword` | `{ identifier }` | `{ sent:true }` |

`user` = `{ id, username, fullName, email, profession, role:'owner'|'worker', profilePicture, pages:[int], actions:[string], isOwner:bool }`

### Users (requires `users.manage`)
| action | payload | data |
|---|---|---|
| `listUsers` | `{}` | `{ users:[user] }` |
| `getUser` | `{ userId }` | `{ user }` |
| `setPermissions` | `{ userId, pages:[int], actions:[string] }` | `{ user }` |
| `suspendUser` | `{ userId, suspended:bool }` | `{ user }` |

### Inventory
| action | payload | data |
|---|---|---|
| `listInventory` | `{ query?, category?, lowStockOnly? }` | `{ items:[item] }` |
| `getItem` | `{ itemId }` | `{ item }` |
| `addItem` | `{ item }` | `{ item }`  (requires `inventory.add`) |
| `removeItem` | `{ itemId }` | `{ removed:true }` (requires `inventory.remove`) |
| `editItem` | `{ itemId, changes, expectedLastUpdate? }` | `{ item }` (requires `inventory.edit`) |
| `restockItem` | `{ itemId, quantityAdded, buyingPricePerUom?, expiryDate? }` | `{ item, restock }` (requires `inventory.restock`) |
| `listRestockHistory` | `{ itemId?, from?, to? }` | `{ rows:[restock] }` |

`item` = `{ itemId, itemName, description, category, uom, buyingPrice, rate, currentStock, reorderLevel, expiryDate, dosage, contraindications, lastUpdateDate, lastUpdater }`

### Sales
| action | payload | data |
|---|---|---|
| `createSale` | `{ saleId?, clientName?, paymentMode:'cash'\|'lipa_namba', items:[{ itemId, itemName, quantity, sellingPrice, buyingPrice }], timestamp? }` | `{ sale }` (requires `sales.create`) |
| `listSales` | `{ from?, to?, userId?, paymentMode?, itemName?, status? }` | `{ sales:[sale] }` |
| `getSale` | `{ saleId }` | `{ sale }` |
| `editSale` | `{ saleId, changes:{ items?, paymentMode?, clientName?, status? } }` | `{ sale }` (requires `sales.edit`) |
| `confirmSale` | `{ saleId }` | `{ sale }` (requires `sales.confirm`) |

`sale` = `{ saleId, timestamp, items:[{ itemName, quantity, sellingPrice, buyingPrice, profit }], total, cashAmount, lipaNambaAmount, paymentMode, dispenser, clientName, status }`

### Assistant
| action | payload | data |
|---|---|---|
| `searchItems` | `{ query }` | `{ items:[assistantItem] }` |
| `searchByUse` | `{ use }` | `{ items:[assistantItem] }` |

`assistantItem` = `{ itemId, itemName, description, category, uom, rate, dosage, contraindications }`

### Reports
| action | payload | data |
|---|---|---|
| `dashboard` | `{ date? }` | `{ day, week, month, year }` (each a summary) |
| `dailyReport` | `{ date }` | `{ summary, series }` |
| `weeklyReport` | `{ date }` | `{ summary, series }` |
| `monthlyReport` | `{ month }` (YYYY-MM) | `{ summary, series }` |
| `annualReport` | `{ year }` | `{ summary, series }` |

`summary` = `{ salesCount, itemsSold, cashAmount, lipaNambaAmount, totalAmount, profit }`
`series` = array of `{ label, salesCount, itemsSold, cashAmount, lipaNambaAmount, totalAmount, profit }`

### Alerts
| action | payload | data |
|---|---|---|
| `listAlerts` | `{}` | `{ stockouts:[item], expiring:[{ item, expiryDate, monthsLeft, band }] }` |
| `listDLQ` | `{}` | `{ rows:[dlqRow] }` |

Expiry `band`: `green`(6) `yellow`(5) `purple`(4) `pink`(3) `deepred`(1-2).

### System (public)
| action | payload | data |
|---|---|---|
| `health` | `{}` | `{ status:'ok', serverTime, sheets:{...} }` |
| `version` | `{}` | `{ version }` |
| `syncBatch` | `{ operations:[{ opId, action, payload, clientTime }] }` | `{ results:[{ opId, ok, data, error }] }` |

`syncBatch` replays each queued offline operation through the normal handler. Every mutation is
de-duplicated by `opId` (idempotency) so a replay never double-writes.

---

## Permission keys (actions)

`sales.create`, `sales.edit`, `sales.confirm`,
`inventory.restock`, `inventory.add`, `inventory.remove`, `inventory.edit`,
`reports.view`, `users.manage`, `alerts.view`, `assistant.search`, `settings.manage`.

The **owner** implicitly holds every page and every action.
A **worker** holds only what the owner granted.
Page 9 (User Control Panel) is never grantable to a worker.

## Session tokens

- Opaque token = `base64url(random) . base64url(hmac)` signed with a secret in Apps Script Script Properties.
- Stored in the `Sessions` sheet with `expiresAt` (default 12h). `refreshToken` issues a new one (rotation).
- Sent as `token` in the body (and `Authorization: Bearer` accepted by the gateway).
